disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: This screening report is an AI-assisted point-of-care screening aid for rural community triage. It does NOT constitute a clinical diagnosis, ICD-10 categorization, radiographic Kellgren-Lawrence grade, or prognostic determination. Clinical correlation by a qualified medical practitioner is required.

reasons.community_screening: Community-based early osteoarthritis risk screening and functional mobility triage.

low: Maintain active low-impact physical exercise including daily brisk walking and gentle knee mobility drills.
Adopt joint-friendly postural habits during agricultural or domestic household tasks.
Repeat community screening in 12 months or sooner if knee stiffness or discomfort increases.
moderate: Initiate structured quadriceps and hamstring strengthening exercises twice daily.
Avoid prolonged static squatting or carrying unassisted heavy field loads where possible.
Schedule a primary health center (PHC) medical review with a community medical officer within 4–6 weeks for clinical evaluation.
high: Prioritize prompt medical evaluation at Community Health Center (CHC) or District Hospital orthopedic outpatient clinic.
Avoid deep knee flexion, abrupt high-impact loads, and unassisted hill climbing until evaluated.
Consult physician regarding weight-bearing support, pain management, and dedicated physical therapy.
indeterminate: Repeat sensor screening ensuring firm sensor band placement, minimum baseline stillness, and full repetition arc.
If sensor quality check fails on repeat session, proceed directly with primary health center clinical consultation.

activity_guidance.low: Encourage routine daily activities, regular village walking, and joint flexibility routines.
activity_guidance.moderate: Advise paced daily activity with periodic sitting rest periods. Limit deep squatting and heavy lifting.
activity_guidance.high: Recommend modified daily duties minimizing steep climbs, heavy lifting, and prolonged kneeling. Use walking support if unsteady.
activity_guidance.indeterminate: Continue usual daily precautions while arranging repeat sensor assessment or medical review.

referral.routine: Routine follow-up at next village health camp.
referral.phc_review: Recommended PHC medical officer review within 4–6 weeks.
referral.priority_chc: Priority referral to CHC / District Hospital Orthopedic OPD.
referral.technical_retake: Technical retake recommended; refer to PHC if symptoms persist.

red_flag_banner: RED FLAG PRESENT — Refer to a doctor. Do not rely on this screening.

red_flag_names.fever_hot_knee: Fever with hot, red, swollen knee
red_flag_names.unexplained_weight_loss_bone_pain: Unexplained weight loss with bone pain

qc_reasons.ok: Adequate acoustic contact and complete movement cycles.
qc_reasons.few_cycles: Fewer than 3 valid movement cycles — repeat the recording.
qc_reasons.link_errors: Data-link errors during recording — repeat the recording.
qc_reasons.low_quality: Most movements were outside the protocol (small range or pauses) — result shown with low confidence; repeat with slow, full bends.

model_note: Prototype model trained on synthetic data — not clinically validated.

events_per_cycle.up: More joint clicks (crepitus events) per movement than typical

spectral_centroid.up: Joint sound energy at higher frequencies
spectral_centroid.down: Joint sound energy shifted to lower frequencies
